specsDir.description: Where spec folders (prd.md, design.md, tasks.md) live.

baseBranch.description: What branches and reviews diff against.

order.description: Build order (area names) when several areas change.

rules.description: Cross-area rules every plan and review must respect.

launchConfigs.description: .claude/launch.json configuration names to start for browser checks.

name.description: Short name used in designs and tasks.

path.description: Folder relative to the repo root; "." for the whole repo.

conventions.description: File with the area's rules, usually its CLAUDE.md.

ui.description: UI changes here get the ui-reviewer.

openapi.description: OpenAPI file (relative to the repo root) that is the source of truth for this area's HTTP API.

onEdit.description: Run after each Edit/Write of a matching file, from the area's path, with the file in $FILE.

match.description: Regex on the file path. Default: every file.

check.description: Fast checks run from the area's path before a turn ends, when the session edited this area.

verify.description: Full definition of done, run from the repo root.

testOne.description: Runs one test file (appended), from the area's path.
